note: Example/demo submodule of form_mode_manager. On install it imports config: a node_form_mode_example content type (body + field_picture), a node 'contributor' form mode (core.entity_form_mode.node.contributor) with a form display, a view display, and a 'contributor' role; plus a front-page controller at /form_mode_manager_examples and a hook_menu_local_actions_alter. No configure route, no config schema, no permissions of its own. Trivial submodule => 3 easy / 1 medium / 1 hard. Medium reads the shipped node_form_mode_example content type. Hard activates the shipped 'contributor' form mode on the Article bundle (config-only; node CRUD is avoided because a broken shared-site field storage prevents node deletion).

evals.prompt: What does the form_mode_manager_examples submodule install so I can try Form Mode Manager, and is it meant for production?
evals.expected_output: It's a demo/example module (not for production). It installs a node_form_mode_example content type, a 'contributor' node form mode and role, form/view displays, and a /form_mode_manager_examples front page.

evals.prompt: The form_mode_manager_examples module adds a demo landing page. What path is it at, and what does it link to?
evals.expected_output: Route form_mode_manager_examples.front_page at /form_mode_manager_examples (permission access content); it links to the node_form_mode_example add form and shows an 'Add node as contributor' local action.

evals.prompt: Which node form mode does the form_mode_manager_examples submodule ship as a working example, and on which content type?
evals.expected_output: A 'contributor' node form mode (core.entity_form_mode.node.contributor), shipped active on the node_form_mode_example content type.

evals.prompt: The form_mode_manager_examples module is installed on this site. Inspect the live site and give the machine name of the demo content type it provides.
evals.expected_output: node_form_mode_example (a node_type shipped by the examples submodule).

evals.prompt: The 'contributor' node form mode shipped by form_mode_manager_examples is currently only enabled on the demo content type. Activate that same 'contributor' form mode on the Article content type so it becomes usable there too, and apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: A core.entity_form_display.node.article.contributor config entity exists (enable the contributor form mode in the Article Manage form display 'Custom Display settings').
